question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum rate of interest for the period from 11 February 2023 to 25 April 2023.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total days from 11 Feb to 25 Apr 2023 = 17 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 25 (Apr) = 73 days.

Time in years = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 year.

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7 × 1) ÷ (100 × 5) = 28.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28.**
